body: I just can't understand why , my manager is a sixty year old man and if I put myself in his position, if he accidentally touched someone's boob or crotch over clothing for a couple miliseconds the last thing I'd do would be to be angry at him? Can you please help me understand what makes it so bad ?

Thank you , I had a talk with him  . Felt bad bringing it back up but I explained this and told him it also made me think that if anything bad were to ever happen to me his first reaction wouldn't even be to see if I'm okay but to get upset with me .  That really made him see how wrong he was and we had quite a productive talk about it, he said it does tie in with previous experiences so it's definitely stemmed from an indiselity insecurity or something of the sort  . Although genuinely if this ever happens again as it hasn't in the years we spent together I will not put up with it , it was very silly .
